'The seven texts' no longer fits the table after MSG-P4-001 was added. Its condition (no session, section 12.1) is known but shown as not specified.
Section 11 places SCR-46 'in P3'. Neither the story text shown nor the item supports this.
Contract version row points to section 12.2 (consumed reads) for the /v1 operations. The provided operations are in section 12.1.
